output_list.criticism: The function transfer() has a vulnerability of Integer Overflow. The function calculates the value of _value by multiplying msg.value and unitsOneEthCanBuy. If the multiplication overflows, the function will not execute correctly.

The function transferFrom() has a vulnerability of Integer Overflow. The function calculates the value of _value by multiplying allowed[_from][msg.sender] and _value. If the multiplication overflows, the function will not execute correctly.

The function approveAndCall() has a vulnerability of Integer Overflow. The function calculates the value of amount by multiplying _value and unitsOneEthCanBuy. If the multiplication overflows, the function will not execute correctly.
